description.narrative: Work on effective cybercrime deterrence improved in line with the EU and international standards. The twinning project will assist competent law enforcement authorities in fulfilling its their commitments with regard to Justice and Home Affairs policies. With regard to the EU integration process, the Pproject will contribute towards the implementation of the Stabilisation and Association Agreement (SAA).The project is structured in two components. First component is the capacity building part and the second component is supporting the development of relevant rules and legislation.
